data.other_hard: Membership in a Protestant church (exceptions in justified cases); Completion of first university degree in a short period of time; Final grades at least good (law: fully satisfactory); Qualification which entitles doctoral studies; Foreign students may apply if admitted to a doctoral programme at a university in Germany
data.evidence_sentence: Every year Studienwerk supports 200 doctoral students of all types of subjects with scholarships and a comprehensive range of educational programmes.
data.notes: Nationality not explicitly stated as open to all; the text only says foreign students may apply if admitted to a German doctoral programme, so nationality_rule left empty. Financial criteria (students' own earnings and living situation) follow Federal Ministry guidelines and are not clearly a hard requirement. Deadline 1 June is given without a year, so recorded as annual. Applications from students in the final stages of their PhD are no longer considered. Scholarship is granted for one year and can be extended to a maximum of three years; the GPA condition for keeping the award is not stated. Protestant membership exceptions apply in justified cases. Listed deadline page is for a PhD scholarship, matching the name in substance but the page title differs.
